title: Compose a reader and a calculation
prompt: Export async countFrom(read: () => Promise<readonly boolean[]>): Promise<number>. Await the reader once, then count the false values. Propagate a rejected read.
hints: Keep reading and counting as separate operations.
Await the reader, then inspect its returned list.
An uncaught rejection propagates to the caller.
checks: await (async () => { let calls = 0; await answer.countFrom(async () => { calls++; return []; }); return calls === 1; })()

wrongAnswers.misconception: Hides a failed read as an empty board.

feedback: Keep reading and counting as separate operations.
